correctness.rationale: For every positive reset rate and angular diffusivity, the first two stationary Fourier moments solve linear generator balance equations. The conditional first harmonic decays as a damped rotation, giving an integrable matrix Green--Kubo formula. Exact symbolic reduction produces the rational complex anisotropy. Its imaginary numerator prevents isotropy at any nonzero angular drift; the only achiral numerator zero is r=d/2. The exact Taylor derivatives at this point establish the avoided-crossing coefficient, not only numerical plausibility. A standalone numerical/symbolic checker independently corroborates formulas and discretized generator convergence.

value.rationale: A natural dispersion-tensor degeneracy at a physically tunable reset rate is exactly removed by intrinsic angular chirality, quantified by a universal linear splitting and rotated principal axes. The distinction between coordinatewise equal diffusivities and full isotropy matters because chirality generates off-diagonal covariance. The result is an all-parameter sharp structural boundary in the same experimentally interpretable model family rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
